title: Order Blocks vs Fair Value Gaps: Which One Actually Gets You Funded in 2026?

script: Order blocks or fair value gaps — traders fight about this daily. But one of them funds accounts. The other blows them. The order block case: price returns to institutional supply or demand. No structure context, no market shift confirmation — you're just guessing at a gap. The R2F Trading verdict: neither wins alone. Stack them.
